question: How many units were sold per category?
referenceSql: SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category
